nodes.description: Public mapping tracking token balances per address
Public token name string
Public token symbol string
Public token decimals (18)
Public total token supply set at construction
Nested mapping of owner to spender approved amounts
Constructor-style initializer assigning totalSupply to deployer and emitting Transfer
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient address
Sets allowance for a spender on behalf of msg.sender
Transfers tokens using an existing allowance on behalf of another address
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner and spender
balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply unconditional state assignment in constructor
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value unchecked arithmetic subtraction in transfer
balanceOf[to] += value unchecked arithmetic addition in transfer
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value unconditional allowance write in approve
balanceOf[from] -= value unchecked arithmetic subtraction in transferFrom
balanceOf[to] += value unchecked arithmetic addition in transferFrom
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value unchecked arithmetic subtraction in transferFrom
Recipient address parameter of transfer

edges.reason: Constructor executes the balance assignment
msg.sender determines which balance is pre-funded with totalSupply
totalSupply value flows into the constructor balance assignment
transfer executes the sender balance deduction
transfer executes the recipient balance addition
msg.sender is used as the balance key for the deduction
value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance without SafeMath
value parameter is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath
to parameter is used as the balance mapping key for the addition
balanceOf state mapping is read and written during deduction
balanceOf state mapping is read and written during addition
approve executes the allowance assignment
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance being written
spender parameter is the spender key of the allowance being written
value parameter is written as the allowance amount
allowance state mapping is written by the assignment
transferFrom executes the source balance deduction
transferFrom executes the recipient balance addition
transferFrom executes the allowance deduction
from parameter is used as the balance key for the deduction
from parameter is used as the outer allowance key for the deduction
to parameter is used as the balance key for the addition
value parameter is subtracted from the source balance without SafeMath
value parameter is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath
value parameter is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath
balanceOf state mapping is read and written during source deduction
balanceOf state mapping is read and written during recipient addition
allowance state mapping is read and written during deduction
msg.sender is used as the spender key of the allowance deduction

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only meaningful inside the transfer function and should be folded into it
Amount parameter is consumed by the transfer unsafe arithmetic operations and should merge into transfer
Parameter belongs solely to the approve function and should be folded into it
Amount parameter is written by the approve allowance assignment and should merge into approve
Parameter is only used within transferFrom and should be folded into it
Parameter is only used within transferFrom and should be folded into it
Amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom arithmetic operations and should merge into transferFrom
